prompts.aMap: Generate a standalone 2:1 equirectangular full-coverage grayscale stellar photospheric INTENSITY texture for BL Ceti, GJ65 A, Luyten726-8 A. Not a sphere, no sky, no text, no lighting gradient; seamless left/right, polar compression compatible. Independent bespoke invented morphology, absolutely no reuse of observed Sun imagery or any other body's map. Primary research Kervella2016 radius0.165Rsun mass0.1225Msun; MacDonald&Mullan2017 inferred2784±58K. Cool partly ionized molecular hydrogen/helium stellar gas, not solid ground. Barnes2017 Doppler inference shows smaller sparse midlatitude spots plus some high-latitude groups, mean model filling~1.7%; use a sparse irregular distribution with a few northern high-latitude darker gas regions and finely mottled convection at subdued contrast. Invent longitudes and detailed cellular pattern, not reconstruction of measured map. Neutral gray intensities only because renderer applies approximate tint. Gas texture rather than lava/rock/craters; no literal magnetic field lines or continent shapes. Clean texture asset, subtle realistic emergent photosphere.
prompts.bMap: Generate a standalone 2:1 equirectangular full-coverage grayscale stellar photospheric INTENSITY texture for UV Ceti, GJ65 B, Luyten726-8 B. Not a sphere, no sky, no text, no global lighting gradient; seamless left/right with polar compression compatible. Independent bespoke morphology and unique seed, no observed Sun or other-body map reuse. Primary constraints radius0.159Rsun mass0.1195Msun, inferred2728±60K MacDonald&Mullan2017. Cool partly ionized molecular hydrogen/helium stellar gas, no solid terrain. Barnes2017 Doppler model suggests larger darker gas spot groups at intermediate latitudes~50-56deg with little circumpolar structure, mean inferred filling~5.6%. Invent several broad irregular midlatitude dark gas groups separated by quiet finely mottled photosphere; darker larger groups than BL Ceti, neither polar cap nor uniform latitude stripes. Convection and longitudes invented, not literal measured geography. Neutral grayscale intensity because renderer provides approximate tint. No molten rock/craters, no magnetic field lines, no text or borders.
